title: Singapore Art Museum at Bras Basah
geometryBasis: Named 39-vertex monument footprint and Bras Basah Road axis. Native 25 m height constrains the cupola. The museum and conservation authority distinguish the central block, chapel and two curving wings.
sectionBasis: The 2013 photograph fixes the stacked white arcade and pediment, terracotta eaves, upper window rhythm and gray dome. Heights between surveyed outline and mapped total are scaled from the front view.
limitations: The model depicts the November 2013 exterior of the former St Joseph’s Institution at 71 Bras Basah Road, during its use by the Singapore Art Museum.

The named polygon fixes the footprint. The cleared photograph constrains the entrance, dome, orange tile, and forecourt openings. Rear openings, the chapel roof section and minor ornament are reconstructed estimates.
The original Terrarium field is preserved. Its elevations climb sharply on the east wing and may include roof or canopy elevations. Model contact uses approximate forecourt paving.
